access.dataset_title: Payroll Based Journal Daily Nurse Staffing

sources.frequency_basis: CMS catalog lists the update frequency as quarterly. Each release adds one calendar quarter, posted some months after the quarter ends.

sources.name: Annual Report of Long-Term Care Facility (nursing home cost reports)

access.how: Download each home's PDF for the new cost year from the DSS cost reports documents page.

sources.frequency_basis: DSS: the cost year runs October 1 to September 30 and the report is due before February 15. DSS posts the reports after that; check from March.
sources.check: Each spring (March to May) until the new year is posted

sources.frequency_basis: The roster is generated from the live license system when requested; there is no release schedule.
